title: Contrasting Effects of Control on Fidelity and Fidelity Deviation in Controlled Teleportation
summary: Teleportation performance is commonly characterized by the average teleportation fidelity, while its variation over input states provides additional information captured by the fidelity deviation. In controlled teleportation, the controller's measurement introduces an additional source of fidelity variation through its measurement outcomes. We investigate the fidelity deviation in controlled teleportation with three-qubit pure states.
